limits: local common Python HTTP/1.1 front end plus framed IPC, not a production framework comparison
closed-loop achieved capacity includes coordinated omission; fixed offered-rate windows include queue time and drops; offers late by more than one arrival interval are scheduler drops
latencies include verified full HTML/CSS body; RPS counts successful responses completed within nominal measured window
every successful response is independently hashed; failures and drained responses stay in accounting
affinity separates assigned physical cores but does not isolate host load/frequency/sibling applications
transport control caches bytes explicitly; actual renderers retain ASTs only, no response cache

publication.extraction: All numeric samples/accounting and source/input fingerprints retained; private source/runtime paths use role placeholders; ephemeral process/port identifiers omitted. Theme source/output, raw logs and sampled addresses remain local.
notes: Final ecd default release, original prepared four-product homepage, no RPC. Client sent is after connection acquisition, not independent server admission. Pool request counters aggregate all windows. CPU bounds start after READY and exclude init/warmup; per-window snapshots span setup/ramp/window/drain. VmHWM is process-lifetime including init/warmup; instantaneous RSS is different. Shared-host transport gate does not establish identical uncontended conditions for every serial window.
